title: observability: token-level metrics/tracing, dashboards, and alert tuning (extended)
description:
Motivation: Provide richer token-level observability (cost & latency breakdown) end-to-end and reduce noisy alerts that surfaced during recent spikes. This PR adds new token-level metrics, tracing spans for token generation and KV cache hits, updated Grafana dashboards with cost/latency breakdown per-route and per-model, and tuned alert thresholds and aggregation windows to reduce paging during transient blips.

Summary of changes: 1) Instrumentation: add token_cost_total, token_latency_bucketed, kv_cache_hit_ratio and per-request token_count labels. Add tracing spans: token_generate, kv_cache_lookup, runtime_scheduler_wait. 2) Metrics pipeline: add metric transformations to compute per-route per-model cost and 95/99 latency. 3) Dashboards: new dashboards under observability/dashboards/token-level-cost-latency.json and small updates to per-model overview dashboards. 4) Alerts: lower sensitivity on token-latency alert by increasing evaluation window to 10m and adding a secondary alert on SLO burn rate. 5) Tests & CI: unit tests for metric conversion and end-to-end integration smoke test for tracing tags.

Implementation details: - Runtime: light-weight counters incremented in the token emission hot path; counters tagged with model, route, region, license_tier. KV cache instrumentation added to fast path to emit hit/miss counters with minimal overhead (atomic counters, sampling for very high QPS). - Tracing: spans are added around token emission and cache lookup, with attributes token_index, seq_len, cached (bool). Sampling kept at 1% by default in prod and elevated in canaries. - Metrics ingestion: new Prometheus exposition endpoints and updated metric relabel rules in the pipeline to derive per-token cost using model-based price table (config-driven). Summaries and histograms configured with explicit buckets tuned from production percentiles. - Dashboards: Grafana JSON dashboards included; panels for token cost heatmap (route x model), token-latency distribution, top n routes by token cost, and correlation panel showing cache hit ratio vs latency. - Alerts: existing noisy alert token-latency-high (now token-latency-slo-breach) replaced with two-level alerts: alert when sustained 99th percentile exceeds target for 10m, and a burn-rate style alert for SLOs that considers traffic volume.

Testing and rollout: Unit tests added for metric arithmetic and histogram bucketing. Integration tests simulate synthetic traffic to validate tag propagation through tracing and metrics pipeline. Feature gated behind an observability flag (feature/observability/token-level) and rolled out to canary region first with elevated tracing sampling. Gradual rollout documented in rollout notes.

Operational notes: - Default sampling and aggregation windows chosen to balance cost and signal. - Cost per-token uses model price table stored in config; changes to prices require ops change and will be versioned. - Backfill plan included for dashboards to compute historic SLO burn for the past 7 days using archived metrics.

References: Linear: ENG-10234, ENG-10877; Related PRs: pr-31245, pr-30512.

review_thread_summary: Reviewer Miguel: requested lowering tracing sampling in high-QPS paths; Author (Ava): implemented sampling config and added tests. Reviewer Priya: asked to increase histogram buckets for tail latency; Author: adjusted buckets and added integration test validating percentiles. Reviewer Ethan: requested alert tuning to reduce noise; Author: added two-level alerting and updated alert docs. Final approvals after CI green.
notes_for_ops: Rollout plan: enable feature flag in us-east-1 canary, monitoring for 24h with elevated tracing sampling. If SLO burn > 2% for 30m, rollback feature flag. Update model_price_table for any pricing changes before full rollout.
